queue.grants_rule: Jacob 2026-10-30 19:30 CR: each hotkey whose turn since the held-out gate went live (e275) was RED with 0 < weighted_z <= 1.00 gets ONE fresh free-file turn, ahead of the queue (oldest RED epoch first). It is used only by a real turn: a missing or invalid file is a skip and the grant stays open. The hotkey must still be registered. next lists granted hotkeys only while their file is valid.
queue.order_rule: One turn per hotkey and per registration (UID + registration block), permanently, pass or fail. Base order = registration block, then UID (UID 0 excluded); served hotkeys and registrations leave the queue. Squat-trim (Jacob 2026-11-05): expected wait = max(1 day, N_ahead / turn_rate) with N_ahead = unserved registrations ahead in registration-block order and turn_rate = turns/day over the last 24h; a registration with no present+valid batch file whose age exceeds 2x that expected wait is moved to the back of the queue (keeps eligibility; ordered among demoted keys by registration block). Any key with a valid file is never demoted. At each turn the first queue member whose batch file is present and valid takes the turn; members without a valid file are skipped, not charged, and keep their (possibly demoted) place. next = the next 8 unserved members with a valid file now, in the demoted order: a forecast; the turn decides.

squat_trim.rule: age > 2 x max(1 day, N_ahead/turn_rate) and no valid file -> back of queue; valid file never demoted; recomputed each turn
